name: NPM-GP/L
tagline: 12-second print cycle with automatic changeover and solder handling

intro.text: The Panasonic NPM-GP/L is the newest screen printer in the NPM-G series. It recovers the solder left on the mask after printing and moves it to the mask for the next model, and its APC-5M function monitors the solder paste in real time to time maintenance and track conditions.

items: Automatic model changeover, solder transfer and solder supply cut downtime
Cleaning after each cycle, with maintenance timed from live data
Receives ongoing autonomous updates as production demand changes

rows: L 50 × W 50 to L 510 × W 510 mm
12.0 s (PCB L 250 × W 150 mm, incl. transport, positioning, recognition, printing and cleaning)
Single-phase AC 200 / 220 / 230 / 240 V ±10 V, max. 3.3 kVA
0.5 MPa, 30 L/min (motor vacuum) or 400 L/min (ejector vacuum)

blocks.text: Standard specifications from Panasonic, measured under Panasonic-specified conditions. Exchange time varies with neighbouring machines, PCB size and PCB holders.
